fix_subject: Fix #9806 - when an overflow is detected during filter pushdown the pushdown should be halted, instead of claiming the result is always false (which is not the case)
pr_title: Fix #9806 - when an overflow is detected during filter pushdown the pushdown should be halted, instead of claiming the result is always false

labels.summary: When evaluating a constant in a comparison filter overflowed during filter pushdown, the combiner reported the filter as unsatisfiable, which wrongly dropped rows; it now reports unsupported so pushdown is halted.
